questions.question: In Python, a ______ loop repeats actions as long as a certain condition remains True.

In a for loop, you can immediately terminate the loop using the keyword ______.
The keyword ______ is used to skip the current iteration of a loop and continue with the next iteration.
A nested loop occurs when a loop is placed ______ another loop.
Using the function ______ allows you to retrieve both the index and value from a list in a for loop.
In Python, a for loop can have an optional ______ clause that only executes if the loop completes without a break.
The single-line syntax for creating a new list by applying an expression to each element of an iterable is called a ______.
When iterating over two lists simultaneously, the function ______ can be used to pair elements from each list in a single loop.
When you need to iterate over an iterable in reverse order, you can use the built-in function ______ in combination with a for loop.
